redcap:Surveys.title: REDCap Service/Consultation Request
redcap:Surveys.confirmation_email_content:
The REDCap Support Team has received your request and will respond within 48 business hours, but typically much quicker.

Ticket #: [record_id]

Note: If you did not submit a ticket and you're wodering why you are receiving this email, it is becasue you directly emailed the REDCap Support Team and they entered a support request ticket on your behalf since all work done by them must have a corresponding support ticket.
redcap:Surveys.response_limit_custom_text: Thank you for your interest; however, the survey is closed because the maximum number of responses has been reached.

Question.redcap:FormattedTranslatedText:
Fee-based services ($130/hour):
  • Any assistance over the one-hour of free time PER PROJECT (PID).
  • Assistance with data transformations and data imports.
  • Project building/configuration services.
  • Assistance with configuring UF-created External Modules.
  • Assistance with using the API.
Free services:
  • 1 hour of user support per project ID (PID).
  • Account unsuspensions.
  • Quotes for grant applications.
  • Project un-sequestration.

 

Since each REDCap project can only receive up to 1 hour of free assistance (excluding the Free Services listed above), we recommend you first look at the User Guides, Help & FAQs page and the training videos find answers to your questions.

Where can I find free user guides/videos and training classes to help me?
  • Vanderbilt's Video Resources website: https://projectredcap.org/resources/videos/
  • UF-REDCap User Guides: REDCap User Guides
  • Introduction to REDCap class (video): Introduction to REDCap class
  • eConsent User Guide: UF REDCap eConsent User Guide
  • FAQs page in REDCap: Help & FAQs Page
  • UF REDCap FAQs: UF REDCap FAQs
  • REDCap training videos:  REDCap Training Videos
  • Mosio (SMS services) User Guide for UF projects:  Mosio-REDCap user guide
  • Deleting a REDCap project: How to delete a REDCap Project
  • YouTube or Google Search (search for "REDCap" and/or the topic you want to know more about, i.e., "REDCap Sending Surveys" or "REDCap Double Data Entry")
  • Branching Logic (Skip Logic) user guide: Branching Logic in REDCap
  • Making Changes to a Project in Production: Steps for Making Changes to a Project in Production
  • User Rights (adding users to a project): User Rights
  • Creating a REDCap account (for UF-affiliated users): Creating a REDCap Account (UF-affiliated users)
  • Creating Calculations/Scoring in REDCap: Calculated Fields - REDCap How-To Guide
  • Creating reports in REDCap: Creating customized reports in REDCap
  • How to update a project's owner or PI: How to update the project owner or PI or IRB #
  • Requesting REDCap accounts for external users (if you don't want to get them GatorLink accounts): Request form
  • Project Deletion, Exporting Data & Files and Saving REDCap Projects: Project Deletion: Downloading Data and/or the REDCap Project
If your project has used any support time, the amount of free support time remaining will be shown on the Project's Home Page in a yellow banner.

(no free support time remaining)

(0.5 hours of free support time remaining)

If you do not see a yellow banner on the Project's Home page, then the project has not used any of its free support time yet.

Question.TranslatedText: Please describe, in detail, your REDCap problem or question, or why you are requesting a meeting. The more details you can provide the faster we can assist you. Please be as specific as possible by including any applicable details such as: Names of the data collection form(s) or survey(s) with the issue. Names (field label or variable name) of the data field(s) with the issue. How you are sending out your project's surveys and what the survey flow should be (if your questions are related to survey distribution or survey flows) Screenshots of any error messages you are receiving. The reason you are requesting a consultation. Questions about billing/invoicing/needing copies of an invoice? Please contact the CTSI billing team at: ctsi-svcbillingteam@ad.ufl.edu
